Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC12 An error answer carries its status code, 401 or 404 (403 as AC3)
    Given the caller sends the route command without a valid credential, or for a caseId that rwb-case does not hold
    When the request is received
    Then the response is 401 when the credential is not valid, and 404 when the caseId is not held
    Then a missing right answers 403 as AC3 states

  Scenario: AC13 A retried or timed-out activity writes once (activity retry and timeout)
    Given an activity of RouteDecisionWorkflow is retried or does not finish inside its timeout
    When the retry runs
    Then no second decision record and no second item are written, by the idempotency row
    Then the retry count and the activity timeout are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S1-E4009-APP-AC15)

  Scenario: AC14 A consumed call that returns an error writes nothing (exception X5)
    Given the rwb-decision, rwb-case or rwb-access contract mock returns an error response
    When the branch reads the answer
    Then the branch waits and retries on the workflow's schedule
    Then nothing is written and the caller sees 503 with the platform envelope
